title: How Many Are Multiples of 3? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
The list 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 keeps going for 100 numbers. How many are multiples of 3? Vantee tracks the remainders to find a repeating 1, 0, 0 pattern, shows a second way with the triangular-number formula, explains why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you the first 80 numbers to try yourself.
